_readme: GENERATED by scripts/gen-templates.mjs from utils/waTemplateVars.js — edit that, not this. Create these in the sent.dm console (channel: whatsapp, language: en, category: UTILITY). Variables are POSITIONAL ({{1}}, {{2}}, … in body order), which sent.dm sends as var_1..var_N. Two rules Meta enforces: a body may not end in a variable, and a variable should not be an entire URL — which is why the receipt body writes the domain itself and takes only the token. After approval, map key → name in /ops/settings → "sent.dm template map".
_not_required: welcome, welcome_media, onboarded and payment_verifying are deliberately absent. Each one only ever fires as a direct reply to an inbound message, so the 24-hour customer-service window is always open and free text always gets through. A template buys nothing there.
